principles: SAFF foundation in 1955 and FIFA recognition in 1956 are separately gated institutional milestones.
FIFA Big Count 2006 is gated to 2006+ for participation/access context and is not mechanically converted into elite quality.
FIFA Professional Football Report 2023 is gated to 2023+ for professional ecosystem depth.
The large 2023 professional-player and club counts support competition/elite capacity but do not by themselves justify world-leading 9+ scores.
No rankings, tournament results or titles are calibration targets.
